card.reasoning: Each fold imitates training the model on the day the validation block starts. An order bought before that day but delivered (or reviewed) after it had no answer yet on that day, so learning from it would use information from the future. Most dropped rows are the last few weeks of orders before each boundary, still in transit or not yet reviewed then.
